placements.why: The envelope's content is entirely about calibrating and verifying an observatory spectrograph against reference plates. No existing strata category covers this organizational domain, so a new Calibration strata is warranted.
placements.title: Systematic instrument calibration as organizational practice
placements.theme: Observatory instruments require systematic calibration and verification against reference standards to ensure measurement reliability.

placements.title: Spectrograph calibration verified against reference plates across observing band
placements.theme: Observatory spectrograph calibration is established at a target frequency and verified against reference plates to confirm measurement reliability across the full observing band.
placements.why: All four segments cohere around the establishment and verification of the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration — the 88.4 MHz frequency, the instrument identity, and the verification against June reference plates across the full observing band. This names a thematic subject (instrument calibration verification) that future calibration envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact.
